title.en: Camping System Breakdown in World of Warcraft: Forever
title.es: Avería del sistema de acampada en World of Warcraft: Forever

summary.en: Camping System Breakdown in World of Warcraft: Forever...
summary.es: Avería del sistema de acampada en World of Warcraft: para siempre...

contentHtml:
Blizzard has released a blog detailing the Campfire system in WoW: Forever. Learn how camping works and which buffs each profession provides!

Camping in WoW: Forever
Blizzard
View Original
There is something special about seeing another adventurer on the road. Maybe they are headed toward the same quest objective, recovering after a close fight, or simply taking the long way through a dangerous zone. In World of Warcraft: Forever, the Camping system gives those moments more room to grow by turning a simple Cooking Fire into a place where players can rest, prepare, and connect.

The system expands the Cooking profession’s simple Cooking Fire into a Basic Campfire. Once placed, the Basic Campfire creates a shared campsite where nearby players can rest and gain benefits from profession-made camp features before setting out again. Those reasons to linger can turn a roadside pause into a helpful encounter, a trading opportunity, or the start of new friendships.

Camp Features give professions a more visible role in the world. A Basic Campfire can support up to three special crafted objects contributed by nearby players, with each player able to add one. Each profession brings its own form of utility, such as a blacksmith placing a Sharpening Wheel that increases Strength for an hour, a tailor placing a Faction Banner that increases Spirit, or an herbalist placing an Incense Candle that increases Intellect. These effects are variants of buffs normally provided by specific classes and are exclusive with them.

Players sitting or crafting at a campsite for at least 1 minute will gain the benefits from other camp features. This provides an opportunity to get to know your fellow adventurers, and perhaps embark on a journey together.

How Camping and Profession Camp Features Work

Early in your adventures, a simple quest introduces the Camping system and shows how a campfire can become a useful gathering place for players out in the world. Once a profession reaches skill level 20, you can acquire its first campsite items through starter zone quests or purchase them from a profession trainer. Items that require skill level 140 or higher are found through drops in dungeons and raids.

About Professions

Secondary Professions

You can learn all three secondary professions: Cooking, Fishing, and First Aid.

Primary Professions

You can learn two primary professions. These include the gathering professions Skinning, Mining, and Herbalism, as well as the crafting professions Alchemy, Blacksmithing, Enchanting, Engineering, Leatherworking, and Tailoring.
To learn a profession, visit a trainer in the world or in a major city. To unlearn one, open the Professions tab (K) or select it from the menu bar at the bottom of the screen, then click the “X” next to the profession you want to remove. Profession ranks progress from Apprentice to Journeyman, Expert, and finally Artisan.

The Professions tab also shows available recipes and blueprints, their required materials, and whether crafting an item will increase your skill.

The table below lists a sample of each profession’s camp features, required skill levels, and benefits. All Camping features require a campfire to be nearby and share a cooldown of 1 hour.
ProfessionItemSkill Level Details
CookingBasic Campfire1Builds a Basic Campfire that allows cooking and the placement of up to 3 additional camp features. Players sitting or crafting nearby for 1 minute will gain benefits from other camp features
First AidFirst Aid Kit20Unpacks a First Aid Kit that allows you and others sitting nearby to gain 3-56 increased Stamina (level dependent), exclusive with Power Word: Fortitude.
FishingFishing Bowl20Places a small Fishing Bowl that allows you and others sitting nearby to gain 8% increased stats, exclusive with Blessing of Kings.
AlchemyMana Well20Constructs a Mana Well that allows you and others sitting nearby to regenerate 10-29 Mana every 5 seconds (level dependent), mutually exclusive with Blessing of Wisdom.
BlacksmithingSharpening Wheel20Constructs a Sharpening Wheel that grants you and others sitting nearby 6-34 increased Strength (level dependent), mutually exclusive with Strength of Earth Totem.
EnchantingEnchanted Lute20Summons an Enchanted Lute that allows you and others sitting nearby to gain 28-260 Armor, 0-13 increase to all stats, and 0-22 increase to all resistances (level dependent), mutually exclusive with Mark of the Wild.
EngineeringReagent Bot
HerbalismIncense Candle20 Ignites an Incense Candle that allows you and others sitting nearby to gain 2-25 increased Intellect (level dependent), mutually exclusive with Arcane Intellect.
LeatherworkingCamp Tent20 Builds a Camp Tent that allows you and others sitting nearby to increase Rested experience by 5% of a level. No effect if Rested experience already exceeds that value.
SkinningCamp Chair20Assembles a Camp Chair that allows you and others sitting nearby to gain 2% increased critical strike chance with all spells and attacks, exclusive with Moonkin Aura.
TailoringFaction Banner20 Unrolls a Faction Banner that allows you and other members of your faction sitting nearby to gain 14-32 increased Spirit (level dependent), mutually exclusive with Divine Spirit.
Cooks can eventually learn upgraded Campfires that allow five or even 10 objects to be placed at a camp, while other professions unlock helpful conveniences such as Alchemy Laboratories and Tanning Racks.

To receive campsite buffs, players need to sit by the campfire briefly and become rested before returning to the road. That pause makes rest, preparation, and community part of the journey, supporting a playstyle built around traveling at your own pace instead of rushing between capital cities and your objectives.
Choose your campsite carefully. Some places in Azeroth are better suited to a quiet rest than others, and danger can still find you when you stop. On a PvP Ruleset, that risk increases when enemy players come upon your camp.

Whether you are repairing gear, preparing your group, or sharing a fire with passing adventurers, Camping offers another way to live in Azeroth—not just move through it. We’ll see you by the campfire!

contentHtml:
Collect Scarecrow Pepe as a decor reward by completing an achievement during Hallow's End!

Hallow's End Guide


New to Hallow's End 2026, A Frightening Friend has a brand new reward: Scarecrow Pepe! If you've previously gotten this achievement, the decor is retroactively granted, but for anyone needing to find a new bird friend, you can only grab it during the holiday.



This achievement is only available during Hallow's End and requires players to have a level 3 Garrison from the Warlords of Draenor expansion. Head to your Garrison and go to the graveyard:
  • /way 71.2 90.3 in the Horde Garrison
  • /way 40.5 70.2 in the Alliance Garrison
Tip: Click map to zoom
Frostwall: [Level 28]
Tip: Click map to zoom
Lunarfall: [Level 25]
  


You'll find Scarecrow Pepe perched on top of a gravestone. Click him to get the achievement and your new Decor!

contentHtml:
With the Delve Bonus Event Week, you will get bonus Kindo'jan Labyrinth reputation to help level up your reputation faster!

Labyrinth of Kindo'jan


The Delve Bonus Event lasts for the full week and buffs:
  • Labyrinth of Kindo'jan reputation by 25%
  • Delver's Journey by 25%
  • Undercoin gains by 25%
With Patch 12.1.5, the buff now also increases Kindo'jan Labyrinth reputation by 25%. This makes it easier for players to rank up and unlock new power in the Labyrinth and rewards!

title.en: Spirit Conduit Loa Powers Can No Longer Be Used on Kindo'jan - Patch 12.1.5 Hotfixes
title.es: Spirit Conduit Loa Powers ya no se puede usar en Kindo'jan - Parche 12.1.5 Correcciones en Vivo (Hotfixes)

summary.en: Spirit Conduit Loa Powers Can No Longer Be Used on Kindo'jan - Patch 12.1.5 Hotfixes...
summary.es: Spirit Conduit Loa Powers ya no se puede usar en Kindo'yan - Parche 12.1.5 Correcciones en Vivo (Hotfixes)...

contentHtml:
Blizzard has posted hotfixes for today, which prevent Spirits Conduits from being used on the Kindo'jan encounter.

Spirit Conduits are unlocked at Renown 6 of the Labyrinth of Kindo-jan Renown track and grant short 2 minute buffs. One of the strategies that players were using was to leave all the conduits untouched until Kindo-jan was summoned, then quickly pick them all up and absolutely destroy Kindo'jan with a lot of damage. This will no longer work according to the hotfixes.

Labyrinth of Kindo'jan


For End-Game Gearing
  • Crests have been uncapped.
  • Ascendant Venomstones have been unlocked.
  • Conquest and Bloody Tokens are now uncapped.
For Everyday Players
  • Blizzard has fixed another bugged scenario in Labyrinths
  • The Spirit Conduits cannot be used on Kindo-jan.
  • Various questing bugs were fixed.
Blizzard
View Original
Here you'll find a list of hotfixes that address various issues related to World of Warcraft: Midnight, Mists of Pandaria Classic, Season of Discovery, Burning Crusade Classic, WoW Classic Era, and Hardcore. Some of the hotfixes below take effect the moment they were implemented, while others may require scheduled realm restarts to go into effect. Please keep in mind that some issues cannot be addressed without a client-side patch update. This list will be updated as additional hotfixes are applied.

Hotfixes

October 20, 2026

Achievements
  • The availability of Fabled: Let Me Solo Him: Kindo'jan has been extended and can now be earned until weekly maintenance during the week of October 27.
Labyrinth
  • Fixed an issue that could sometimes prevent the “Fools and Curses” scenario from completing.
  • Fixed an issue where Spirit Conduit Loa powers could be used during Kindo'jan's fight.
Items
  • Mistcrests are now uncapped.
  • Ascendant Venomstones are now available after completing the quest “Ascending with Venomstones”.
  • The Ancient Hash'ey Battle Art glove enchantments can now be applied to Warbound Until Equipped items.
  • The Void Eruption effect on Kith'ix's armor pieces can no longer hit targets you aren't in combat with.
Player versus Player
  • Conquest and Bloody Tokens are now uncapped.
  • The Spoils of War buff is now available – Conquest gains increased by 50% and Honor gains increased by 40% in Battlegrounds and Arenas.
  • The Venomous Equipment Chest is now available for purchase from the conquest quartermaster, Irissa Bloodstar.
Quests
  • The furbolgs required for the quest "Not Quite Nalorakk" have returned from their hibernation.
  • Fixed an issue where spending Nebulous Voidcores on non-raid sources would not grant credit towards completing the "A Nebulous Endeavour" tutorial quest. This objective will be completed the next time a character spends a Nebulous Voidcore on any Season 2 bonus roll source.
  • Resolved an issue where the Skardyn Behemoth could become unattackable, preventing completion of "Draw Its Ire."
  • Fixed an issue that prevented the completion of the Voidstorm quest "To Be Changed".

title.en: Turn Restored Coffer Keys into Ascendant Venomstones by Doing Tier 11 Delves
title.es: Convierte las llaves de cofre restauradas en piedras de veneno ascendentes haciendo profundizaciones de nivel 11

summary.en: Turn Restored Coffer Keys into Ascendant Venomstones by Doing Tier 11 Delves...
summary.es: Convierte las llaves restauradas del cofre en piedras de veneno ascendentes haciendo profundizaciones de nivel 11...

contentHtml:
If you have a lot of Restored Coffer Keys, you can turn them into Ascendant Venomstones by opening Bountiful Chests from Tier 11 Delves and Labyrinths.

Ascendant VenomstonesLabyrinth of Kindo'jan

Restored Coffer Keys

Players can earn up to 600 Coffer Key Shards a week, or 6 Restored Coffer Keys by default. In addition, Naleidea Rivergleam sells 2 more Coffer Keys each week. This means that you can get up to 8 Coffer Keys or 8 Ascendant Venomstones this week by completing Delves on Tier 11.

In Midnight Season 1, players could only acquire a limited amount of Ascendant Venomstone from Delves each day due to the limited number of Bountiful Delves. In Midnight Season 2, Labyrinths offer unlimited runs, allowing you to turn your Restored Coffer Key into Ascendant Venomstones as many times as you want.

 


If you have a lot of Coffer Keys, this is an efficient method of getting Ascendant Venomstones!

Bountiful Delves

There are only 4 Bountiful Delves up per day, which allows you to convert 4 Keys into Ascendant Venomstones by opening the Tier 11 Bountiful chest at the end.

If you want to be more efficient, if you find Dundun inside the Delve once a week, he will make your Delve Abundant and grant you an extra chest, which can turn one extra Restored Coffer Key into Ascendant Venomstone.

 


If you're having trouble finding Dundun in a delve, use the macro to help and talk to him!

/target dundun
/ping [@target] assist
 

Labyrinth

You can complete the Labyrinth of Kindo'jan as many times as you want, and a full clear gets you 3 chests. This allows you to convert 3 Coffer Keys into 3 more Ascendant Venomstones!

If you have a backlog of Restored Coffer Key and want more Ascendant Venomstones, it may be time to spam some Labyrinths.
